positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer Contracting through BGI-LLC for CAE
(formerly L3Harris Link Simulation and Training) 

They develop flight simulation hardware/software for pilot training for the F16, F18, MQ-9 and other platforms

Worked on Radar Simulation

positions.title: Principal Sofware Engineer
positions.description: AESA Radar, Modes/Algorithms, Embedded Systems, C/C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description: GoLang, Docker, AWS, encryption, HSM, swagger

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed C++ code for virtual mobility management entity / Serving GPRS support
node running Linux over Contrail/Openstack, VMware vSphere, and KVM.

Added features while working with a experienced team of developers following the SCRUM development model

Including SGW and PGW selection preferencing for roaming callers

Improved performance through GTP load distribution across signaling VM’s

Doubled MME/SGSN capacity to 1.088 million subscribers using 17 call VM’s

Used telecom protocols involved in MME/SGSN communication for 4G LTE, 3G
UMTS, and 2G GPRS, such as GTP, S5, S11, S1, Diameter/S6, DNS, Gb, Iu, Gn in
various call procedures, such as Attach, RAU, IRAU, TAU, and inter/intra Handover.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed C/C++ code for WatchMaster IP Elite and Ultra embedded Linux cameras on large interdisciplinary engineering team.

Wrote code in all areas including arm based linux kernel code, application code, web cgi, javascript, css, xhtml, microcontroller code, and ONVIF interface using SOAP.

Was involved in entire product lifecycle of both products from conceptual design, board bring up, mechanical qualification testing, and production.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Performed code-refactoring of MFC based Aloha point of sale system, which improved security, maintenance, and reliability of the entire code base.

Became part of the SSG team and implemented requested enhancements and corrected defects.

Roles included developing, testing, and debugging

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Assisted lead developers and QA team with the testing and debugging of multiple credit card network interface modules for the Palm POS system.

Efforts contributed to the certification of the Conoco/Phillips network interface module for commercial use

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with a Specialization in Artificial Intelligence
